liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Fire On The Mountain** (2 reviews): Bobby's lead coming out of space into Fire, plus Phil locking in, was judged perfect; Fire through to the end of the show is near perfect; Fire into Not Fade Away has an aquatic feel [17][20]
- **Cassidy** (1 review): Acoustic Cassidy and Bird Song are described as hypnotic [20]
- **Franklin's Tower** (1 review): Unconventional placement of Franklin's Tower and Fire in the final electric set makes for strong listening [25]

## Setlist highlights

- **Frankin & Davis preshow**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [29]
- **Brent Intros "Frank & David**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [29]
- **Sage And Spirit**: back after 359 archived shows (1906 days); rare: 3 archived performances [29]
- **Little Sadie**: back after 746 archived shows (3898 days); rare: 7 archived performances [29]
- **ambiance**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [29]
- **Jerry’s Kids Telethon**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [29]
- **Jerry Garcia Interview**: back after 955 archived shows (5143 days); rare: 4 archived performances [29]
- **Steve Parrish Interview #1**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [29]

## The recordings

- **gd1980-10-31.140416.sbd.bershaw.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 58 songs; 283 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1980-10-31.prefm.cousinit-edited.patched.83158.sbeok.flac16**: pre-FM broadcast master; 29 songs; 199 min; rated 4/5 by 6 [6]
- **gd80-10-31.sbd-preFM.cousinit.20377.sbeok.shnf**: pre-FM broadcast master; 29 songs; 187 min; rated 3.7/5 by 23 [7]. Said about its sound: Reviewer hears lots of hiss and suspects multiple cassette generations in this pre-FM master; Reviewer finds both sets clear on this pre-FM master, with audience more prominent during the acoustic set; Reviewer prefers this soundboard's Jack Straw to the audience version and says equalizing could make it a 4-minus recording [18][21][22][24]
- **gd80-10-31.wise.larson.1955.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 30 songs; 196 min; rated 4.64/5 by 11 [8]. Said about its sound: Acoustic set is hard to hear on this audience tape, with some reverb in electric sets, yet it beats the circulating soundboard; Reviewer prefers this soundboard's Jack Straw to the audience version and says equalizing could make it a 4-minus recording; Drums file on this audience recording has many dropouts, and the reviewer seeks a complete version [17][23][26]
- **gd1980-10-31.nak700.rolfe.miller.94270.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 29 songs; 200 min [10]
- **gd1980-10-31.137840.partial.sbd.happyjack.sirmick.sbeok.flac24**: soundboard; 14 songs; 100 min [13]

## Around the show

- Stage talk about: Frankin & Davis [1]
- Notable for an acoustic set being played at Radio City Music Hall [18]
- Reviewer attended 10-30-80 as a first show and saved trying acid for the Halloween night show [27]
- First set was acoustic [1]
- Show was FM broadcast and closed-circuit TV, with an acoustic first set [13]
- Reviewer finds this audience recording presents the show better than the circulating soundboard [17]
- Fire on the Mountain appears cut up on the album Dead Set, unlike here [20]
- Reviewer judges the soundboard Jack Straw better than the audience recording's version [22]
- Dead Set is clearly a chopped version of this material [25]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1980-10-31.140416.sbd.bershaw.flac16**: taped by Alan Bershaw; transferred by Alan Bershaw; source: Source: 10” 1/4 track SBD Feed Master Reels @ 7.5ips; [1]. Also: Soundboard direct recording described as previously uncirculated; show was FM broadcast and closed-circuit TV [1]
- **gd1980-10-31.prefm.cousinit-edited.patched.83158.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Bill Tetzeli; source: Acoustic: PreFM>MSR>R>C>DAT>WAV>SHN; Electric: MSR>R>C>DAT>WAV>SHN [6]. Also: Master audience recording by Sony ECM-280 mics to cassette, then PCM; drums partly patched from circulating DVD audio [6]
- **gd80-10-31.sbd-preFM.cousinit.20377.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Cousinit; source: Soundboard [7]
- **gd80-10-31.wise.larson.1955.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Jim Wise; source: Audience Recording: Sony ECM-280/D-5 [8]
- **gd1980-10-31.nak700.rolfe.miller.94270.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Steve Rolfe; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Nakamichi 700 -> Master Cassette (Sony D5/Maxell UDXL-I & UDXL-II/Dolby B) [10]
- **gd1980-10-31.137840.partial.sbd.happyjack.sirmick.sbeok.flac24**: taped by HappyJack; transferred by SIRMick; source: Source: Soundboard (monitor mix) > Sony TC-D5 > cassette (2nd gen); Taped by Happy Jack and friend; [13]. Also: Partial soundboard whose master was stolen; pitch-corrected, with pops, dropouts and noise repaired [13]

## Art and photos
